The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 351692885d112277), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 46-47. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Fix D∗ > 0, b∗ > 0, and C > 0, and require η∗ < b∗/4 in Equation (6.2). Let U, V be dyadic scales satisfying UV ≍ x, xb∗ ≤ U, V ≤ x1−b∗ . 46 Let Ψ be a fixed smooth function with compact support in a fixed compact subinterval of (0, ∞). Suppose that |αm|, |βn| ≤ LC, and that αm = 0 unless P−(m) > W. There is a fixed exponent B, depending only on these data and the fixed group and band constants, such that the discrepancy hypothesis in Equation (5.4) on α implies X m≍U, n≍V, u≥1 mn=2u+1 A(u)Ψ(u/x)αmβn ≪ xL−D∗ . (6.5) Here the sequence to which the discrepancy hypothesis is applied includes the actual restriction m ≍ U and any additional interval restriction on m. Explicitly, for that restricted sequence one requires X m∈I αmχ(m)mit m ≤ L−B  I ⊂ [1, x2 ], mod(χ) ≤ LB , |t| ≤ LB  . There is no discrepancy hypothesis on β. The constants are uniform over the sequences, scales, and interval restrictions satisfying these conditions.
